body: The route on the map ends at a closed road. A keyring is tucked beneath the last stop, its tag stamped “return”; the return line has been crossed out.
title: The last stop crossed off the van route
gloss: A delivery key remains with a route whose return was cancelled.
rival_reading: A field van could change its route when access changed and leave the key with an old map; the crossed line need not be an order to abandon anyone.

body: The seed sack is wedged against the fertilizer bag in the van. Its stitched mouth is green at one corner; the label on the fertilizer is clean where a thumb would lift it.
title: The seed sack kept beside the fertilizer
gloss: Field stock travelled together with a trace on one seam.
rival_reading: Emergency crews could move farm supplies in a van during a road closure; a stain and clean label do not establish a failed agricultural program.
